name: Bongards Farmers' Market
tagline: Bongards Farmers Market hits milestone 10th year
description: Bongards Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 12984 County Rd 51, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
